label: VLC media player
description: Plays almost any video or audio file. Installed for every user on this computer; may ask for administrator permission once. Does nothing if VLC is already installed, and uninstall only removes it if this setup installed it.
notes: URL source on purpose (proves the url path). sha256 is the vendor-published value (download.videolan.org/.../vlc-3.0.23-win64.exe.sha256), pinned to a version: bump url+sha256 together when VLC updates. Probe: winget VideoLAN.VLC installs this same exe in ~22 s; winget --scope user installs a portable zip instead and `winget uninstall` returned 0 without removing the machine install, so detect is file-only (winget leaves an HKCU ARP stub) and uninstall runs the NSIS uninstaller.
